title: 第13章 虚空罡气第14章 千倍返还先天太虚罡气百倍返还大道丹
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
“你在这里等我，就是为了给我这个东西吗？”
“嗯！”
顾清秋点头，随后像是想起什么，继续说道：“这块玉是我在支脉那边带过来的，不知道是什么，不过我感觉这块玉应该很不凡，神子哥哥给了我这么多东西，就当做是我的回礼吧。”
顾长歌有点意外，没想到顾清秋竟然认真的给自已准备回礼。
而且！
细细感知，他发现顾清秋神魂好像有点虚弱。
重生至尊给的东西，应该不凡吧！
顾长歌想着，也没有客气，从顾清秋手中接过玉佩：“好，谢谢清秋妹妹了，对了，下个月成人礼试炼就要开始了，清秋妹妹这个月实力尽量提高一点，进入个人积分榜前一百可以获得不少资源，我会带你的。”
顾长歌隐晦的提醒了一下。
带带！
那当然就是留几个快噶的凶兽鬼怪，让顾清秋补刀了。
顾清秋：“……”
她眨了眨美眸，万万没想到顾长歌竟然还准备在那个时候给自已开后门。
不过，她点了点头，随后快步离开了。
目送顾清秋离开，顾长歌这才查看手中玉佩。
傻子才会相信刚才顾清秋说的话，一看就是顾清秋故意送的，看样子这是不准备欠自已人情啊。
但是清秋妹妹哟，被我的返还系统给绑定了，你还想跑，那是不可能的。
以后你只能是我顾长歌的人，呵呵。
按照顾清秋的说辞没啥问题，毕竟她之前都没修炼，自然不知道这块玉佩的价值，看起来是拿身上最贵重的东西赠与顾长歌，没毛病。
顾长歌想着，神识开始探入手中玉佩中查看！

“轰”
一股信息洪流出现在顾长歌脑海中，紧接着化作一行大字【虚空罡气】！
无数奥义在脑海中流淌，顾长歌也在这个时候，明白【虚空罡气】是什么神通了。
这竟然是一门基于虚空经创造的圣级防御神通！
虚空罡气如同其名，于虚空中凝练罡气，吞罡气，存于身。
在遇到攻击时，能自动出现并且护主，还具有一定的反伤效果。
这个就十分不可思议。
毕竟自动护主这种能力，无论放在任何防御神通上，都是极其可贵了，更别说是圣级！
如若不是知道虚空经只有两门帝级伴生神通，以及一门圣级伴生神通，他都要以为这虚空罡气是第四门圣级伴生神通了。
虚空经中记载三门神通，三门皆是恐怖的攻击神通！
圣级攻击神通：截天指！
帝级攻击神通：虚空大手印，大虚空术！
不过现在要再增加一门了。
圣级防御神通：虚空罡气！
“有意思，这个应该就是顾清秋重生之前创造出来的神通吧。”
“不止返还赚的盆满锅满，就连顾清秋本人也是一个巨大宝藏啊！”
“虚空罡气侧面补充了我的防御短板！”
“接下来再去寻找一门身法神通，那我就是六边形战士了！
！”
顾长歌心情十分不错。

拿到虚空罡气，顾长歌返回房间，正想要参悟修炼时，忽然想到一个方法！
那就是这门虚空罡气是顾清秋赠予自已的，而且又不是属于系统的东西，那么他又返回去给顾清秋的话，那是不是可以触发返还？
如果可以触发返还，那么他手里的虚空罡气神通，那就再度迎来一波起飞啊。
“不急不急！”
content_en:
"Are you waiting for me here just to give me this thing?"
"Yeah!"
Gu Qingqiu nodded, then seemed to remember something, and continued: "I brought this jade from the branch. I don't know what it is, but I feel that this jade should be very extraordinary. Brother Shenzi has given me so many things, so consider it as my return gift."
Gu Changge was a little surprised. He didn't expect that Gu Qingqiu would seriously prepare a return gift for him.
and!
Feeling carefully, he found that Gu Qingqiu's soul seemed a little weak.
The things given by the Reborn Supreme should be extraordinary!
Gu Changge thought about it and took the jade pendant from Gu Qingqiu without being polite: "Okay, thank you sister Qingqiu. By the way, the adult ceremony trial will begin next month. Sister Qingqiu will try to improve her strength this month. If you enter the top 100 in the personal standings, you can get a lot of resources. I will help you."
Gu Changge gave a vague reminder.
Bring it!
Of course, that would be to leave a few fast beasts and ghosts for Gu Qingqiu to finish off.
Gu Qingqiu: "..."
She blinked her beautiful eyes, never expecting that Gu Changge was planning to open the back door for herself at that time.
However, she nodded and left quickly.
After watching Gu Qingqiu leave, Gu Changge checked the jade pendant in his hand.
Only a fool would believe what Gu Qingqiu said just now. It seemed that Gu Qingqiu had given it to him on purpose. It seemed that he was not prepared to owe himself a favor.
But sister Qingqiu, you are bound by my return system. If you still want to run away, that is impossible.
From now on, you can only be my friend, Gu Changge, haha.
According to the argument of taking care of Qingqiu, there is nothing wrong with it. After all, she has never practiced before, so she naturally doesn't know the value of this jade pendant. It seems that she is giving the most valuable thing on her body to Gu Changge, so there is nothing wrong with it.
As Gu Changge thought, his spiritual consciousness began to poke into the jade pendant in his hand to check!
"Boom"
A torrent of information appeared in Gu Changge's mind, and then turned into a line of big characters [Void Gang Qi]!
Countless mysteries flowed in his mind, and at this time, Gu Changge understood what the magical power of [Void Gang Qi] was.
This turned out to be a holy-level defensive magical power created based on the Void Sutra!
Void Gang Qi is just like its name. It condenses Gang Qi in the void, swallows Gang Qi, and stores it in the body.
When attacked, it can automatically appear and protect the owner, and also has a certain anti-injury effect.
This is very incredible.
After all, the ability to automatically protect the Lord is extremely valuable regardless of any defensive magical power, let alone a saint-level one!
If he hadn't known that the Void Sutra only had two accompanying divine powers at the emperor level and one accompanying divine power at the holy level, he would have thought that the Void Gang Qi was the fourth accompanying divine power at the holy level.
There are three magical powers recorded in the Void Sutra, and all three are terrifying attacking magical powers!
Saint-level magical attack power: Heaven-cutting Finger!
Emperor-level attack powers: Great Void Hand Seal, Great Void Technique!
But now it’s time to add one more door.
Holy level defensive magical power: Void Qi!
"Interesting, this should be the magical power that Gu Qingqiu created before he was reborn."
"Not only is the profit earned by returning the money huge, but Gu Qingqiu himself is also a huge treasure!"
"The Void Gang Qi supplements my defensive shortcomings!"
"Next, if I look for a body skill and magical power, then I will be a hexagonal warrior!
! "
Gu Changge was in a very good mood.
After getting the Void Qi, Gu Changge returned to the room. When he was about to comprehend and practice, he suddenly thought of a method!
That is, this Void Qi was given to him by Gu Qingqiu, and it was not something belonging to the system. So if he returned it to Gu Qingqiu, would that trigger the return?
If the return can be triggered, then the void energy magical power in his hand will take off again.
"No hurry, no hurry!"
